basis: User decision 6 generalised to calendar 2040 (FES 2040, 11 Nov 2026): the guarantee reaches the debt issued or refinanced from 2026 to the model year. Under Ofgem's RAV-weighted 14-year trailing average the calendar-2040 cost-of-debt allowance is set by yields of 2027-2040 (and refinancing of 1/14th of the balance a year), every year of which is inside a 2026-2040 window, so the whole allowance is repriced. network_finance_account.derived_pass_through(2040) gives this setting.
sources: Ofgem RIIO-3 Final Determinations Finance Annex (Dec 2025) paras 2.10 and 2.17 pp.14-15 (RAV-weighted 14-year trailing average, refinancing aligned to the trailing period); ED3 Sector Specific Methodology Decision Finance Annex (21 May 2026) paras 2.82-2.91 pp.21-23

basis: Low end for 2040: transmission's 14-year trailing average (2027-2040) is inside the 2026-2040 window (1.0); distribution on the ED2-style simple 17-year trailing average spans 2024-2040, of which 15 of 17 years (2026-2040) are inside the window, so 15/17 = 0.8824 of the allowance is repriced (equal weights, declared; derived_pass_through refuses a straddling window, so the share is written here).
sources: RIIO-ED2 Final Determinations Finance Annex (Nov 2022) p.9 and footnote 39 (https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/sites/default/files/2022-11/RIIO-ED2%20Final%20Determinations%20Finance%20Annex.pdf)

basis: Long run: every notional pound of network debt refinanced under the guarantee and repriced (unchanged from the CP30 year).
